tasks.subject: PR Task 1: Recovery code generation and derivation
tasks.description:
**Goal:** src/recovery.ts mints a Crockford base32 recovery code, derives recoveryKey/recoveryAuth (600k PBKDF2, distinct salt prefix), and wraps/unwraps a DEK.

**Files:** Create src/recovery.ts, tests/recovery.test.ts; modify src/vault.ts (export toBase64/fromBase64/cachedKey), package.json.

**Verify:** `node --import tsx --test tests/recovery.test.ts` -> 8 pass; `npm run build` green.

Full steps: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-13-password-recovery.md, Task 1.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/recovery.ts", "src/vault.ts", "tests/recovery.test.ts", "package.json"], "verifyCommand": "node --import tsx --test tests/recovery.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["26 chars, 6 groups, no I/L/O/U", "600k rounds, recovery salt prefix", "case/dash-insensitive normalization", "wrap/unwrap round-trip, wrong key throws", "recoveryAuth != authHash for same string"]}
```

**Verify:** `node --import tsx --test tests/recover-endpoints.test.mjs` -> 12 pass including the write-order assertion.

tasks.subject: PR Task 4: Version-tagged blobs
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Blobs declare which key opens them (v1 master, v2 DEK), so a half-migrated account stays readable with no global flag.

**Files:** Modify src/vault.ts (BLOB_VERSION_*, sealJson version param, openBlob, MissingKeyError), src/history.ts (keys as parameters), src/App.tsx call sites; create tests/migration.test.ts; modify package.json.

**Verify:** `node --import tsx --test tests/migration.test.ts` -> 6 pass; test:offline green.

Full steps: plan Task 4.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/vault.ts", "src/history.ts", "src/App.tsx", "tests/migration.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "node --import tsx --test tests/migration.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["sealJson defaults to v1", "openBlob routes by tag", "absent version treated as v1", "MissingKeyError not a silent fallback", "wrong key still throws"]}
```

tasks.subject: PR Task 5: Setup and migration orchestration
tasks.description:
**Goal:** setupRecovery provisions DEK + code writing the DEK record BEFORE re-encrypting; ensureMigrated self-heals on every sign-in; syncVault and vault reads move onto the DEK.

**Files:** Modify src/recovery.ts, src/App.tsx; create functions/api/auth/recover/register.js.

CRITICAL (plan Step 3b): syncVault currently reseals with the device key at v1 - left unchanged it overwrites a migrated vault and the blob becomes unopenable after a reset.

**Verify:** `npm run build` -> 0; test:offline green.

Full steps: plan Task 5.


tasks.subject: PR Task 7: The reset flow UI
tasks.description:

**Verify:** browser - register, save key, note code, sign out, reset, confirm key survives and a new code is issued; wrong code gives one generic error and the old password still works.

Full steps: plan Task 7. Reset must refuse when not fully migrated (recovery.resetBlocked).
